import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
test('a helper check', () => {
  const sub = () => { assert.ok(true); };
  sub();
});
test('unit states under the real service manager', async (t) => {
  const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
  assert.ok(r);
  const sub = () => {
    if (!process.env.FIXTURE_NEVER) return;
    assert.fail('the subtest checks ran');
  };
  await t.test('its unit', sub);
});
